Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

refute verb

also rebut, rebuttal, disprove, refutation

classical

Ter. Ph. 2.3.54: sī id falsum fuerat, fīlius cūr nōn refellit? (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 196

refellō, refellere, refellī

verb, third conjugation

refute, show to be false

Other words

  • dissolvō, dissolvere, dissolvī, dissolūtum — rebut, refute (an argument)

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Cic. Rosc. Am. 82: crīminātiō tōta dissolūta est (Lewis & Short); Traupman 196

  • dissolūtiō, dissolūtiōnis f. — a rebuttal, a refutation

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Cic. Clu. 3: crīminum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 196

  • crīmen dīluere — to rebut a charge

    also used · classical · Cic. Mil. 27 (Lewis & Short s.v. dīluō)

See also prove, defence.

SourcesLewis & Short: refello · Lewis & Short: dissolvo · Lewis & Short: dissolutio · Lewis & Short: diluo
